title: The Fragrance of the New Life
english: Concerning the newly baptized by the blessed Amphilochius, Bishop of Iconium, for the resurrection of our Savior Jesus Christ.

When the gloom of winter is passed by the season of spring, various birds flying through the air signify the sweetness of the season to men with honeyed songs; then also sweet swallows, cutting the air with sharp flight and running past the heads of men, strike the local sound of a flower's bloom into the ears of men. Then it is possible to see the air clear and the clouds and the faces of men bright, being adjusted as an imitation of serenity; for indeed the sounds of birds delight the hearing, and the clear air brightens the eye, and the brilliance of various flowers sweetens the sight, and the manifold breath of the herbs restores the sense of smell.

And this delight indeed it provides to men, beloved, the earthly and near spring; but our divine and incorruptible spring, Christ, having thickened the meadow of the church with spiritual violets, roses, and lilies, brightens the sight through faith and fills the receptacle of our heart with the fragrance of the divine. For who among the faithful is not now rejoicing? And who now does not exult, when he sees the newly baptized shining like bright lilies within the folds of their garments, and having obtained the golden faith in the midst of their heart? There you will find, beloved, having gazed with the eyes of the heart, the heart of the faithful as a deep violet, being made purple by the blood of Jesus; for the flame-leaved rose from the Virgin Mary...

Destruction has been driven out. What kind of meadow has acquired such a fragrance as our meadow, because of the perfuming of the Spirit? Smell the newly enlightened one and you will find in him the immortal fragrance of the Spirit, that is to say, the myrrh of the heavenly anointing.

Here, like the fathers, the phoenixes, having cut off the heavy weights of victory, yield sweeter fruits of love; here the birds of beautiful voices, the psalmists, sing the psalms in harmony with God; here the virgin, offering to God the pure incense of prayer like a clean dove, rejoices; here temperance, sacrificing the branch of purity to God like Abraham sacrificed Isaac, delights; here the branches of mercy, bearing much fruit, extending the branch of goodness to the poor, delight the Lord and nourish the needy.

Let the virgin sing, saying: 'Let my prayer be directed as incense before you, Lord' (Ps 141:2). Let the merciful man say: 'But I am like a green olive tree flourishing in the house of God; for he shall blossom like a phoenix, and shall increase like a cedar in Lebanon' (Ps 52:8).

Now the gloomy winter of the devil has fled and the bright radiance of the heavenly meadow has dawned; now the mourning of the dead has been driven away, for the light of the resurrection has come. Let us all sing together the new song, for it is fitting for the new citizenship to have a new and blessed song. Let us sing the new song, for behold Adam has been made new, for the old sin has vanished, behold all things have become new.
